parsed.summary: Tracing the drawing against the specification, every reference, part name, value and net label matches: the 0 Ω jumpers R9–R14, the 1 kΩ series R3/R4, the bias network R1/R2/R5/R6/R7/R8/R15, the 100 µF servo bank C1–C4, the 0.1 µF C5, D1 (SS54) / D2 (PMEG3030EP), Q1 (IRLML6402) / Q2 (BC857) and U1 (MAX3485) are all present with the stated values and the schematic annotations ('Short R10, R10 for Core2 and CoreS3 / Short R9, R11 for others', 'Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo', the diode F-voltage notes) are reproduced verbatim. The power rails (+3V3/+5V/BAT/GND), the PortC UART→MAX3485→TTL servo-bus path, the PWM GPIO→J3/J8 pin-3 path and the battery/external-5V supply paths are connected consistently with the intended PWM-vs-serial trade-off, so the drawing does not support any deviation from the intended design.
